sourceDecision: Retain production. compareValues accepts unknown operands and defaults kind="text", direction="asc"; it calls scalar for each operand. The complete scalar declaration returns null for null, undefined, "", "-", and "unknown" before kind handling. It delegates quantity, parses date through Date.parse(String(value)), number through Number(value) with finite-result checks, and declares anchored age/count patterns; age/count results and text String(value) are literal constructions only, not evaluated runtime behavior. compareValues returns its null-result comparison before the direction expression. For non-null scalar results it declares array first/second-component subtraction, numeric subtraction, or natural.compare(String(first), String(second)); natural is declared with undefined locale, numeric:true and sensitivity:"base". Its final return uses order only for direction === "asc", otherwise -order. This placement leaves the null-result branch outside that reversal in source; it is not runtime ordering/collation correctness or a cross-locale guarantee. MetadataTable supplies exact selected property operands, column?.sort and sortDir, retaining the independent falsy-primary original-ID localeCompare fallback, memo dependencies and post-sort100 slice. The two targeted saved metadata sources select public functions without MetadataTable/scalar/compareValues and replace MetadataTable with a props-only stub or string placeholder. No comparator, scalar, callback, hook, sorting, render, AST, model or test is invoked. No concrete supported correction compatible with frozen expectations was established.
